releaseNotes:
• Complete 7-Category Mobile Health Data Hub: Seamless collection and dashboard synchronization of Activity & Motion, Exercise & Workouts, Location & Environmental, Body Metrics & Vitals, Sleep & Recovery, Nutrition & Hydration, and Cycle & Health Tracking.
• Multi-Source Ingestion: Direct integration with Android SensorManager (hardware step & pressure sensors), LocationManager (GPS satellites), Health Connect permissions & query bridge, Camera PPG optical heart rate measurement, and Bluetooth smart peripherals.
• Comprehensive Dashboard Sync: Real-time interactive Mobile Health Hub card on Dashboard and Analytics with Category Filter Pills (Motion, Workouts, Location, Vitals, Sleep, Nutrition, Cycle), one-tap 'Sync Now' synchronization, and live Camera PPG pulse measurement.
• Strict Real-Data Integrity: Unrecorded or idle metrics displayed strictly as '-' with authentic flatline baselines on charts when inactive.
